checks: The Ministry of Justice extended its K-ETA temporary exemption for the already designated eligible passport holders through 31 December 2026, Korean time. Eligible travelers may still apply voluntarily.
South Korea; temporary waiver for participating passports only
Republic of Korea Ministry of Justice, K-ETA
Check the exact passport in the official checker, any further extension, and underlying visa requirements. Arrival card exemptions are separate.
Korea Immigration Service permits online submission beginning three days before arrival and identifies exemptions for registered foreign residents, valid K-ETA holders and qualifying crew.
South Korea; foreign entrants subject to the e-Arrival Card process
Check the traveler category, Korea Standard Time and current procedures. A temporary K-ETA waiver alone does not confer the valid-holder exemption.
Korea's food and drug ministry administers approval for travelers bringing covered narcotic or psychotropic medicines for their own treatment.
South Korea; accompanied controlled personal medication
Ministry of Food and Drug Safety
Check the active ingredient, advance application, quantity and current supporting documents.
Korea Customs Service publishes a standard personal baggage allowance based on taxable value and different conditions for categories such as agricultural items, beverage alcohol and tobacco.
South Korea; accompanied personal baggage and duty treatment
Check the latest category limits, age restrictions, separate permits and whether goods are restricted regardless of value.
Korea Customs Service identifies sexually inappropriate materials among prohibited passenger goods.
South Korea; prohibition on covered passenger imports
Verify precise legal definitions and distinctions among printed material, recordings and electronic files before publishing. Other publications are unreviewed.
Korea Customs Service requires an arrival declaration for covered means of payment exceeding USD 10,000 equivalent.
South Korea; passenger arrivals and covered means of payment
Check included payment instruments and cross-check outbound rules for the traveler classification.
Korea Customs Service identifies departure procedures for covered means of payment, some high-value articles intended to return and precious metals that are not personal belongings.
South Korea; customs departure and covered goods
Check route, citizenship or residency, item classification and declared value; export permits and immigration exit procedures are separate.
Incheon Airport instructs travelers bringing covered animals or livestock goods to present the required quarantine documents and undergo inspection.
Incheon passenger arrivals in South Korea; plant and product-specific requirements checked separately
Check origin and commodity with the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency, including prohibitions or origin-specific certificates before arrival.
Incheon Airport explains veterinary quarantine documentation for inbound dogs and cats and warns that animals without a required certificate are subject to return.
Incheon passenger arrivals with dogs or cats
Check APQA requirements for the animal's origin, age, identification, rabies testing, certificate validity and transit.

Seoul's municipal guidance describes flight approval requirements for designated restricted areas regardless of drone weight and purpose and distinguishes aerial photography permissions from flight approval.
Seoul municipal guidance; applicable airspace and operation only
Check current civil aviation rules, maps, visitor credentials, exact flight and aerial imagery procedures. Customs import is a separate investigation.

The Korean transport ministry announced a two-power-bank carriage limit and a prohibition on use and charging aboard covered flights. Incheon and Korean Air provide separate carriage and approval details.
Republic of Korea aviation safety measures and published passenger implementation
Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport
Check actual operating airline and route, maximum watt-hours, appearance of ratings, terminal protection and approval requirements. Airport guidance: https://airport.kr/ap_en/1433/subview.do
Taiwan's National Immigration Agency announced in July 2026 that the online TWAC submission window increased from three days to seven days before arrival for covered travelers.
Taiwan; TWAC filing window and applicable traveler categories
The earlier English rollout notice and user manual describe three days. Check the latest portal, entry exemptions and application to the traveler's documents.
Taiwan's Civil Aviation Administration provides a validation application for foreign drone registrations, inspections and remote pilot licenses.
Taiwan; foreign operators and the approval process applicable to their operation
Check aircraft and operator class, validity period, case-specific approval and local restricted areas. Customs import remains a separate question.
Taiwan FDA guidance explains reporting with a physician's certificate for eligible personal travel with specified Schedule 1, 2 or 3 controlled drugs.
Taiwan border; eligible personal-use controlled medication
Check current documentation, quantity, scheduling and details of the specific medicine. Entry and exit situations are both covered by the guidance.
EVA Air limits carriage to two power banks per person from 31 March 2026 and describes their carriage in the cabin.
EVA Air operating policy; not territory-wide airport or customs rules
Check device rating, approval, in-flight use policy and the operating carrier on codeshares.
India's DGCA issued a safety advisory concerning carriage of a specifically identified recalled-risk power bank model across flights to, from or within India.
India aviation; device-specific DGCA safety advisory covering passenger baggage and cargo
Check the advisory date, exact device identifier and whether a later notice supersedes it. This does not establish ordinary power-bank quantity or watt-hour limits.
Vietnam Airlines lists detachable lithium batteries and power banks as carry-on-only items and posts separate recalled-device notices.
Vietnam Airlines operating policy; carry-on versus checked baggage
Check date, operating carrier, rating, approval, quantity, current recall list and use in-flight. Other Vietnamese operators and airport procedures require separate evidence.
Avianca's published policy allows up to two power banks in the cabin at up to 100 Wh each. It also requires protection from short circuits and prohibits charging them from aircraft power ports.
Avianca-operated flights under the cited carrier policy
Confirm operating carrier on codeshares, route-specific screening and rules on using the power bank for a personal device.
Canada's air transport security authority directs passengers to pack power banks in carry-on baggage.
CATSA screening and passenger guidance in Canada
Check current Transport Canada rules, carrier conditions, rating and quantity. The dated travel guidance does not establish implementation of every 2026 ICAO change.

New Zealand's aviation authority describes carry-on-only treatment and short-circuit protection for spare lithium batteries including power banks, with airline approval for the higher-capacity range the page describes.
New Zealand aviation passenger guidance; spare lithium batteries and portable chargers
Civil Aviation Authority of New Zealand
Check the separate flex-volt change, current operator policy and treatment of power banks compared with other spare batteries.

Peru's migration legislation generally requires a passport to have six months of validity from arrival when used for entry, while allowing other recognized travel documents under applicable agreements.
Peru entry; passport validity and alternative treaty documents
Congress of the Republic of Peru, Legislative Decree 1582
Check current law, whether another recognized document applies, passport-specific visa requirements and admission at the relevant crossing.
SUNAT identifies dutiable, restricted, temporary-import and other covered goods for which an arriving traveler must present a baggage declaration.
Check item classification, required permits, family filing and electronic versus physical procedures.
SUNAT requires declaring covered cash and negotiable instruments above USD 10,000 equivalent when entering or leaving.
Peru border; inbound and outbound carried funds
Check statutory caps, approved transfer channels, form and instrument classifications separately.
Peru's transport ministry identifies drone registration, pilot accreditation, and the applicable overflight permission as separate procedures for covered operations.
Peru aviation; operation authorization guidance under the applicable RPAS regime
Peru Ministry of Transport and Communications
Check subsequent law and procedures, visitor eligibility, purpose, local protected or heritage site rules and import requirements.
Costa Rica's official tourism guidance describes evidence of onward or return travel for visitors and identifies eligible commercial ground transport among acceptable examples.
Costa Rica visitor entry; proof of departure arrangements
Check immigration policy for the actual passport, allowed stay, vehicle or ticket type and port. The tourism page uses simplified wording in its traveler FAQ.
Costa Rica's tourism authority identifies a valid passport or applicable travel document and distinguishes visa requirements by nationality.
Check the current Immigration Directorate nationality group, exact validity and visa conditions. Transit rules and border discretion need separate review.
